title: Printing the count sheet from the Inactive tab lists only the inactive tracked parts
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). QAPL-I1, QAPL-I2, QAPL-I3 are inactive here. Setup: make the untracked part QAPL-U2 inactive with PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":["<QAPL-U2 id>"],"status":"inactive","note":"QA"}; set it back to active after the test. DevTools Network tab open.
custom_steps:
1. Open Parts > Inventory (/parts/inventory) and click the Inactive tab (tab_inactive_inventory).
  2. Open the ⋮ actions menu (button_inventory_actions) and pick Cycle count (menu_item_inventory_cycle_count).
  3. Click Print (button_print_count_sheet) and look at the request in the Network tab.
  4. Open the printed count sheet and read the parts it lists.
  5. Cancel the count, click the Active tab, start Cycle count again and click Print.
custom_expected:
1. The Inactive tab lists QAPL-I1, QAPL-I2, QAPL-I3 and QAPL-U2 (Total Qty reads Not Tracked); no active part such as QAPL-T1 is listed.
  2. Count mode starts over the Inactive tab's parts only; the QAPL-U2 row shows Not Tracked in the count column with no count input.
  3. GET /api/inventory/count-sheet-pdf is sent with status=inactive and the count sheet PDF is produced.
  4. The sheet lists only tracked parts shown on the Inactive tab (QAPL-I1, QAPL-I2, QAPL-I3 with their bin rows); no active part (e.g. QAPL-T1) is on it and the untracked QAPL-U2 is never on it.
  5. The request is sent with status=active; the sheet lists active tracked parts only: none of QAPL-I1…I3 and not the untracked QAPL-U1.
